rows.answer_text: Visakoivu Oy holds sahkourakointioikeudet class S1, valid until 2027-09-30. Class S1 is the broadest classification in the Finnish electrical contracting scheme and encompasses the scope of class S2, so this requirement is met.

Visakoivu Oy has multiple reference projects exceeding the required minimum value, including a LVI-ylapito puitesopimus for Keski-Vaaran kaupunki, a municipal client, covering school properties, with a contract value of EUR 1,120,000.

Visakoivu Oy proposes service level targets differentiated by priority category: faults affecting safety, heating or continued use of a school or day-care building are treated as emergency priority; faults causing material inconvenience but no immediate risk are treated as urgent; and planned, non-urgent work follows the agreed maintenance schedule. Specific response and completion time targets by category will be set out in the SLA schedule agreed with Vuorikylan kunta at contract start.

During the course of the work, Visakoivu Oy applies the environmental management arrangements of our NMSB 74210:2015 environmental management system, covering waste segregation, spill prevention, and minimising noise and disruption to school and day-care operation during working hours.

Quality control and testing follow the documented procedures of our NMSB 7310:2015 quality management system: work is carried out against a task-specific checklist, tested for correct function on completion, and signed off by a supervisor before the job is closed. Non-conformities are logged and tracked to resolution.

The proposed HVAC system maintenance agreement covers scheduled preventive maintenance (filter changes, coil cleaning, control calibration), corrective repair, and refrigerant handling carried out under our F-kaasuasetuksen mukainen patevyys, together with condition reporting after each visit and an annual summary report to the client.

Visakoivu Oy proposes a limitation of liability for property damage and personal injury aligned with the cover under our toiminnan vastuuvakuutus of EUR 2,000,000 per occurrence. Liability arising from professional error is separately covered under our own ammatillinen vastuuvakuutus, with the specific limit to be confirmed during negotiation of contract terms; in all cases indirect or consequential loss is excluded.

Visakoivu Oy proposes an annual price indexation clause tied to a published Finnish cost index for property maintenance services (e.g. the Finnish Statistical Bureau's kiinteistön ylapidon kustannusindeksi), applied once per calendar year on the agreement anniversary.

Visakoivu Oy does not intend to use subcontractors for this framework agreement; the work will be delivered by our own LVI, electrical and building automation teams, so the Subcontractor List (Appendix 3) is not applicable. Should this change during the contract term, an updated list will be provided in line with Section 6.1.
This tender is submitted as a single PDF file, without password protection, in accordance with Section 6.2.
Pricing in this tender is quoted in EUR per square metre per year, as required, and not as a monthly rate.
This tender is submitted via Vuorikylan kunta's electronic tender submission system ahead of the deadline of 15 May 2026, 12:00 Helsinki time.

The maintenance visit schedule proposed for the properties in Appendix 2 combines fixed preventive visits for electrical and HVAC systems, timed to statutory inspection intervals and manufacturer recommendations, with additional visits triggered by condition reports or fault calls. The full visit calendar for the initial contract year will be agreed with Vuorikylan kunta before contract start.

Waste arising from the works is sorted on site into the fractions required by the municipality's waste management rules (e.g. metal, electrical/electronic waste, refrigerants, mixed waste) and removed by licensed waste carriers, in line with our NMSB 74210:2015 environmental management arrangements.

Visakoivu Oy operates an environmental management system certified to NMSB 74210:2015, covering waste sorting, chemical and refrigerant handling, and monitoring of environmental aspects across our maintenance operations; a description of the system is attached to this tender as required by Annex A.3.

general_sections.cover_letter: Visakoivu Oy is pleased to submit this tender for the electrical and HVAC maintenance framework agreement covering Vuorikylan kunta's municipal buildings. We provide technical and property maintenance services across Central Finland, including for public sector clients, and would welcome the opportunity to support the municipality's schools, day-care centres and administrative premises.
general_sections.company_overview: Visakoivu Oy is a technical and property services company based in Jyvaskyla, offering HVAC, electrical, building automation and facilities maintenance to public and private clients across Central Finland. Our public sector work includes framework agreements and outsourced maintenance for municipal and regional property portfolios.
